Description: ReleasePilot non-production deployment. Existing VPC/NAT/ACM required; review costs before deployment.

PublicSubnets.Description: Two public ALB subnets in different AZs

PrivateSubnets.Description: Two private subnets with NAT egress for GitHub/OpenAI

CertificateArn.Description: ACM certificate in this region for AppOrigin

BackendImage.Description: Immutable ECR backend image URI, preferably digest

FrontendImage.Description: Immutable ECR frontend URI built with API_INTERNAL_URL=http://api.releasepilot:8000

ProviderSecretArn.Description: Secrets Manager JSON: OPENAI_API_KEY, GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET, GITHUB_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, DEMO_PASSWORD

DesiredCount.Description: Start at zero; run migrations before setting one

Properties.AlarmDescription: Analysis backlog older than five minutes
